CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress RDP port to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to RDP port (TCP: 3389).
Risk: This port manages Remote Desktop Protocol connections. Attackers conduct credential stuffing attacks to gain interactive desktop access, deploy ransomware directly to user sessions, or capture screens/keystrokes from active sessions.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
